verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm documentation describes the GPU computing stack (runtimes, libraries, tools) as open source and supporting Linux, so the user-space software for Instinct GPUs is documented as open. However, nothing in the pack specifically states that the kernel driver is open source or upstream in Linux, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux kernel driver support for MI355X, and independent or hands-on confirmation of running it on an open driver.
